data.name: Incident.Form.Title.Events
data.value: G PC Health Check — events around an incident

data.name: Incident.Form.Title.Processes
data.value: G PC Health Check — process details

data.name: Incident.Form.Intro.Events
data.value: Local Application and System logs. Specify an interval in Windows local time (up to 7 days). Collection starts only on request; at most 1000 records per log. Search and filters work on the collected snapshot.

data.name: Incident.Form.Intro.Processes
data.value: Current process snapshot: PID, start time, path, command, and memory. Owner lookup is requested separately for the selected row. Nothing is launched or terminated. Unavailable fields are marked; a missing path does not imply maliciousness.

data.name: Incident.Form.NotCollected
data.value: No snapshot has been collected yet.

data.name: Incident.Form.CancelRequested
data.value: Cancellation requested; waiting for the data provider to return.

data.name: Incident.Form.TimeAmbiguous
data.value: The selected time is ambiguous because of a time-zone transition; refine the interval boundaries.

data.name: Incident.Form.EventSnapshot
data.value: Snapshot {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}: {1}. Interval {2:O} — {3:O}. {4}. Visible after filtering: {5}.

data.name: Incident.Form.StaleWindow
data.value: The interval changed. Showing the previous snapshot from {0:HH:mm:ss}, interval {1:O} — {2:O}. Run collection again for the new interval. {3}

data.name: Incident.Form.ProcessSnapshot
data.value: Snapshot {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}: {1}. Stored {2}; visible {3}; rows with warnings {4}. Time and owner refer to the current process, not to a historical event.

data.name: Incident.Form.EventDetail
Incident.Form.ProcessDetail
Incident.Form.ExportDescription
data.value: The report contains event messages, names, paths, and process commands. Do not publish it without review.

data.name: Incident.Report.Boundary
data.value: Events that occur at the same time do not prove the cause of an incident. A PID in an event identifies the emitter, not necessarily the failing application, and must not be automatically correlated with a current process. Processes are a separate current snapshot, not history. Collection completeness is not a health assessment. Search is limited to the collected snapshot; events that are missing or were deleted earlier cannot be recovered.

data.name: Incident.Report.Title
data.value: G PC Health Check — incident review

data.name: Incident.Report.EventCounts
data.value: Stored {0} events; {1} match the current filter.

data.name: Incident.Report.ProcessCounts
data.value: Stored {0} processes; {1} match the filter; {2} records have warnings.

data.name: Incident.Report.ProcessBoundary
data.value: An empty path/command or unknown owner is not evidence of maliciousness. Commands are displayed only; processes are not launched, terminated, or modified.

data.name: Incident.Report.FullEvidence
data.value: Full records and warnings are in HTML/JSON; the report contains the entire snapshot, not only filtered rows.

data.name: Incident.Report.Process.Headers
data.value: PID / process|Created / PPID / session|Path / command|Memory / threads / handles|Warnings

data.name: Incident.Query.InvalidWindow
data.value: The interval must be positive and no longer than 7 days.

data.name: Incident.Events.Timeout
data.value: 20 seconds elapsed between provider calls; the log was not read completely.

data.name: Incident.Events.Limit
data.value: The {0}-record limit was reached; older results were not read.

data.name: Incident.Events.BadTimestamp
data.value: A record without a confirmed timestamp inside the interval was skipped.

data.name: Incident.Events.MessageUnavailable
data.value: Record ID {0}: event text is not fully available ({1}); metadata was preserved.

data.name: Incident.Events.Cancelled
data.value: Collection cancelled; only records already received are shown.

data.name: Incident.Processes.Timeout
data.value: 20 seconds elapsed between WMI calls; the list is incomplete.

data.name: Incident.Processes.Limit

data.name: Incident.Processes.Cancelled
data.value: Collection cancelled; the list may be incomplete.

data.name: Incident.Owner.NoCreation
data.value: No creation time is available, so it cannot be confirmed that the PID still belongs to the selected process.

data.name: Incident.Owner.Stale
data.value: The process exited or the PID now belongs to another process. Refresh the list.

data.name: Incident.Owner.Changed
data.value: Identity changed during the check; the returned owner was discarded.

data.name: Incident.Owner.Unavailable
data.value: WMI did not return an owner.

data.name: Incident.Owner.Verified
data.value: PID and CreationDate matched before and after GetOwner. This is a point-in-time observation, not a permanent association.

data.name: Incident.Source.AllowedLogs

data.value: WMI returned a process without a PID.
